structural_change: sl2: (1) a dedicated pin register on f0..f3 (4 x 293 b) and fault inside the cell, with no load but the pin (the body's feed flops also load the head logic and were placed mid-cell); +1 cycle on the posted feed. (2) outline 172.8 x 129.6 instead of 172.776 x 518.376 (sl1: util 4 %, TT insertion 499.9 ps pre-route / R 379 routed): every flop within ~65 um of its face. (3) every port on its own range at >= 2 tracks, placed pin by pin.

reroute_reason.note: output pin stage on f0..f3 and fault (+1 cycle), asked by the per-pair die hop check (results/arch/pinreg_audit_1013/pairs/qwen_rom_tp8.md): f0 / f1 launched 462-465 ps after the compensated clock from mid-cell flops; smaller outline
